results.title: Harshad Chopda and Shivangi Joshi's Emotional Moments Spark Dating Speculations on Lock Upp
results.description: In the latest episode of Lock Upp: Sach Ya Sazaa, Harshad Chopda and Shivangi Joshi's emotional interactions have led to speculation about their relationship. Content creator Apoorva Mukhija confronted the duo, suggesting their behavior resembled that of a couple in love. As Shivangi expressed her feelings after defeating Harshad in a nomination task, the emotional exchange left contestants surprised. The upcoming Judgement Day promises more drama as contestants face elimination and audience opinions are shared. Will their bond withstand the scrutiny?
